seoTitle: Brevard Public Schools Calendar 2026-2027: Holidays, Breaks, PDF & ICS
seoDescription: Verified Brevard Public Schools 2026-2027 calendar with Aug 10 first day, May 26 last day, Friday early release, Spring Break, hurricane make-up note, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: Brevard students in grades 1–12 start August 10, followed by kindergarten August 13 and pre-kindergarten August 17. The district counts 180 pupil days and 190 teacher paid days and publishes Hurricane Make-up Days separately.

calendarNotes: Brevard Public Schools starts the 2026-2027 school year for students on Monday, August 10, 2026 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Kindergarten begins August 13 and pre-kindergarten begins August 17. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 4 with students and teachers returning January 5, and Spring Break runs March 22-26. The official calendar totals 180 pupil days and 190 teacher paid days and links families to a separate document identifying Hurricane Make-up Days.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Brevard Public Schools start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Brevard Public Schools students is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Brevard Public Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. The teacher post-planning and last teacher day is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Brevard Public Schools in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Monday, January 4, 2027. Students and teachers return Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Brevard Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Brevard 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official 2026-2027 Brevard Public Schools calendar lists 180 pupil days and 190 teacher paid days.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Brevard kindergarten and pre-kindergarten students start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of kindergarten is Thursday, August 13, 2026. The first day of pre-kindergarten is Monday, August 17, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Brevard have early release Fridays in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official 2026-2027 calendar lists many Friday early release days, beginning with the first early release day on Friday, August 21, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Where are Brevard hurricane make-up days listed?
calendarFaqs.a: The official district calendar links to a separate document identifying Hurricane Make-up Days. Families should check that district source after any storm closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download the Brevard Public Schools calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Brevard Public Schools printable district calendar source linked on this page. MySchoolDates also provides a printable PDF and ICS calendar file based on the reviewed calendar records.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the Brevard Public Schools calendar official?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar is published by Brevard Public Schools. MySchoolDates provides a searchable summary, printable tools, and calendar files based on reviewed official BPS calendar sources, but BPS remains the source of record for final calendar changes.

customSections.label: Brevard Calendar Track Information
customSections.content: This page summarizes the Brevard Public Schools 2026-2027 traditional district calendar. Kindergarten, pre-kindergarten, testing, athletics, graduation, hurricane make-up decisions, and campus events may use separate schedule details, so families should verify program-specific dates with the school or district.

customSections.label: Brevard School Dates Parents Often Miss
customSections.content: The Brevard school calendar includes several planning details beyond the main holiday list. These dates are especially easy to miss when families only check the first day, last day, Winter Break, and Spring Break.

groups.label: Start-of-year details
items: Kindergarten starts Thursday, August 13, 2026, after the main first student day.
The first Friday early release day is August 21, 2026.

groups.label: Midyear and end-of-year details
items: December exam days are also early release days from December 16-18, 2026.
The official calendar points families to a separate Hurricane Make-up Days document.
May exam early release dates begin May 24, 2027, before the May 26 last student day.

customSections.label: 2026-2027 Brevard Calendar Highlights
customSections.content: The 2026-2027 Brevard calendar has several planning details that are easier to understand in context than in a PDF date list alone.

groups.label: Earlier school start
items: The first student day moves from August 11 in 2025 to Monday, August 10, 2026.
Kindergarten starts Thursday, August 13, and pre-kindergarten starts Monday, August 17, so younger-student schedules need separate confirmation.

groups.label: Winter planning window
items: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 4, 2027.
Students and teachers return Tuesday, January 5, 2027, which creates a clean post-holiday restart before the first semester ends.

groups.label: Early release remains important
items: Friday early release dates continue throughout the year, with the first listed early release day on August 21, 2026.
December and May exam windows also include early release days, so families should not rely only on the major holiday list.
